text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council amended the Public Appointments process to authorize the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on May 22, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Chris Forbell Donna Howard Navin Katyal John Masterson Karen Pugliese
